character.name: Disco Ball
character.description: A classic mirrored disco ball: a sphere covered in small square mirror tiles reflecting colorful glints of light (pink, blue, gold), hanging from a metal chain attached at the top. Render it as a plain, naturalistic object - no face, not anthropomorphized, glossy reflective mirror tile texture with sparkle highlights.

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
